title: Find Minimum In Rotated Sorted Array
description:
An array of **distinct** integers was sorted in increasing order and then **rotated**: some number of elements were moved, in order, from the front to the back. For example, `[1, 3, 5, 8, 9]` rotated by 3 becomes `[8, 9, 1, 3, 5]`. A rotation by `0` (or by the full length) leaves the array sorted.

Given the rotated array `nums`, return its **smallest** element.

Your solution should run in **O(log n)** time.
constraints: All values in nums are distinct
nums is a sorted array rotated by some amount

examples.explanation: The original array was [1, 3, 5, 8, 9]; the minimum 1 now sits at index 3.
The array is not rotated at all, so the minimum is the first element.
[-2, 7] rotated by one: the minimum is at the end.

tests.note: large n=20000, rotated near the end
large n=20000, rotated in the middle

seedMeta.notes: O(log n) is stated but not enforceable at this input size (a linear scan also passes).
